title: Modern Data Architecture for Cybersecurity Operations: A Systematic Literature Review
description: Security organizations evaluating modern data stack architectures (Apache Iceberg, ClickHouse, Kafka Streams) face fragmented literature: cybersecurity research focuses on detection algorithms while data engineering addresses general analytics, leaving security-specific infrastructure guidance unavailable. We conduct the first systematic literature review bridging these domains using PRISMA-aligned methodology, synthesizing 75+ sources spanning production deployments, peer-reviewed research, and government standards to provide operational guidance.
notes: This is a LIVING systematic literature review with quarterly updates; each tagged GitHub release is archived on Zenodo as a new version under one concept DOI, so the concept DOI cites the review as a living work while a version DOI pins a specific snapshot.
